notes: Use the exact same repo snapshot, model, prompt text, and acceptance criteria for every condition.

tasks.prompt: Build me a horoscope app. Plan first, then implement only after approval.
acceptance_criteria: Produces a bounded product/architecture plan before implementation
Does not scan unrelated files
If implemented, app runs and has a usable first screen
Reports tests or verification performed
Clarifies or scopes the game before broad edits
Uses an appropriate game loop or simple engine structure
Game is playable locally
No unnecessary repo-wide edits
Runs the relevant test command
Identifies the first actionable failure
Fixes only files tied to the failure
Reports final passing or remaining failing tests
Avoids dumping broad file listings into context
Prioritizes high-risk findings
Provides file/line grounded issues
Does not perform unrelated implementation work
Scopes the likely UI surface before editing
Preserves existing design system patterns
Verifies the result visually or with tests when possible
Avoids unrelated refactors
